title: Count Vowels in a String
question: Read a line of text and count the English vowels a, e, i, o, and u without case sensitivity.
code:
text = input("Text: ")
vowels = "aeiou"
count = sum(1 for char in text.lower() if char in vowels)
print("Vowels:", count)
expected_output:
For input MyIDE Library:
Text: MyIDE Library
Vowels: 5
explanation: lower() makes matching case-insensitive, and the generator counts characters found in the vowel string.
